title: Gus, on his Thursday run

greeting.text: The bell. The wiry man from last night, steadier, with something folded in his fist.
Bins. Thursday. And I brought this, 'cause it's been eating me. Found it in the ute. Staff Christmas do, two years back.
A photograph. Two people in Corrigan's shirts. He holds it up beside your face, and his hand begins to shake again.

annoyed: Stop looking at me and look at the bloody photo.

notes.wrist: The same scabbed knuckles. The same cord-thick veins.
notes.reflection: His back, in the mirror. And two shapes behind the counter that he keeps not looking at.
notes.shadow: One shadow. It is shaking slightly.

topics.answer: Sam. And Wren. Them. You. Except it's not, is it. You're too... you're too tidy. Sam had a chip in his front tooth.
...Don't. Don't go and put one in. Jesus Christ.

topics.ask: Gus. Go home. Don't come back up here.
topics.answer: You're warning me. Whatever you are, you're warning me. ...Right. Right.

wren.arrive: He came back. With paper. Sam, take that off him.
wren.adviceLine: He knows. Look at his face, he knows. We can't let him drive back down with that photo. Put him in the back, Sam. I'll talk to him.

after.serve: He's gone down the hill with a photograph of us. Of them. I hope you know what you've done.
after.shelter: He's quiet now. I burned the photo in the sink. You don't need to see it.
after.turnAway: The photo went with him. That's the second-worst way that could have gone.

serve.text: Take the photo to Tarrow. Show the rangers.
He does not turn his back on you until he is through the door.

turnAway.text: Bins are done. Off you go.
Yeah. Yeah, I'm going. I'm not coming Thursdays any more.

shelter.text: Come and sit out the back a minute. You've had a shock.
...Have I. Yeah. Yeah, maybe I have.

walkout.text: He takes the photo with him.

report.serve: A council contractor has handed rangers a photograph of the Corrigan's night staff and a statement we are still trying to understand.
report.turnAway: A council contractor says he will no longer service Corrigan's Roadhouse. He would not give a reason over the radio.
report.walkout: A council contractor says he will no longer service Corrigan's Roadhouse. He would not give a reason over the radio.
report.shelter: A council ute is parked at Corrigan's with the keys in it. The contractor's wife has rung the station four times.
report.missed: The bins at Corrigan's were not collected.
